column1: # Rows db.html.* (line RG T4a2, 2026-11-20): -html, NCBI's bytes of formats 0 and 18 with -db (and with -subject, a subject:PATH cell, where a registry row needs a subject without ids), the cases of the survey T/t4 of line RG (SURVEY_T4.md section 1; the covers cell names each case, `T4 <id>`). Databases: the T2 ids databases ../db_search/of18/ps_ids and ns_ids, the plain ps_plain there, the id-mix databases ../db_search/html/pmix_ids (pir, prf, pat, tpg, gi+gb, gnl|TI, sp+emb, a sequence with nine deflines (D7), lcl, gi only) and nmix_ids (gi only, gi+emb, tpe, gnl|TI, pat, gb+ref), the taxonomy database ../seqdb/taxdb/good; queries and the -subject file in ../fasta/html (the -subject rows' inputs) and ../db_search/html. Run directories (cwd=) with their .ncbirc and FMTCFG files, and the $NCBI directories, in ../db_search/html/rc (README.md of ../db_search). Frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 on ws (env_blast), but the rows whose stderr holds an exception trace (a source path: the malformed .ncbirc and InitConfig rows, `official binary` in covers), frozen with the local official binary ncbi-blast-2.17.0+ (its build path, as LOSAT prints it). Freeze one such row alone with db_search_fixtures.py freeze --only <row id>.

# Rows db.html.bp.* (line RG T4a2): the five-program basics are db.html.<bp|bn|bx|tn|tx>.di.f0 (D1-D9 per program); blastp alone carries the options (-num_alignments 0, -num_descriptions 0, -line_length 30, -max_hsps 1, -show_gis, -parse_deflines), the id kinds of a protein database (dm), the plain database (BL_ORD_ID), format 18 with its taxonomy database, the registry and environment rows of sections 1.7 and 1.8 (rc_*, env_*: [BLASTFMTUTIL] PROTOCOL http: and empty, [TAX_BROWSER], [LOCAL_ID] TOOL_URL through ./.ncbirc, FMTCFG and $NCBI, GETURL_DEBUG with and without a configuration file, NCBI_DONT_USE_NCBIRC, lower-case names, [FEATURE_INFO] and [BLAST] keys that change nothing, a malformed ./.ncbirc), the malformed InitConfig rows of section 1.9 (cfg.*: FMTCFG=bad.rc in the run directory, $NCBI/.ncbirc, $NCBI/bad.rc; L = -subject ps_spec.faa, D = -db ps_ids; exit 255 after the description header, but -num_descriptions 0 (each HSP `alignment skipped`, exit 0) and a query without hits (the file is read lazily)), and T4a0's review D1 (pe.f18: an empty [BLASTFMTUTIL] PROTOCOL= gives `//` in plain format 18). NCBI_CONFIG_PATH (T4 bp.di.f0.cfgpath.h) has no row: the runner has no token for it.

# Rows db.html.bp.noout.* and db.html.bp.plain.* (line RG T4a2, series F D-36 review2, 2026-11-20): -html with -outfmt 13 and 14 and no -out (NCBI's file-name error, exit 1, before -html matters) and with -outfmt 5, 6 and 7 (NCBI's bytes equal those of the run without -html); db and query of db.html.bp.di.f0; frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 on ws (env_blast).

# Rows db.html.<tag>.*.rc_rep*, .rc_bom* (line RG T4a2 fix 1, 2026-11-23, review b B1 = review a F2): with -html NCBI reads the run directory's ./.ncbirc for each reference of the prolog, for the description table of each query with hits (x_InitDefline, also with -num_descriptions 0) and for its alignments (x_InitAlignParams, not with -num_alignments 0), each read with the file's posts on stderr (rc/rep: Found multiple PROTOCOL settings; rc/bom: Error reading the registry), and InitConfig's GETURL_DEBUG line at the first id link of the run; a query's warning comes before its report's posts.
